newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnian Nov production up 4.8 pct m/m, 80 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian Nov production up 4.8 pct m/m, 80 pct y/y.

text.p: The Statistics Bureau of Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation issued the following economic indicator details on Monday.

NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of the territory of Bosnia-Hercegovina. No data are available for remaining 49 percent. Jan-Nov industrial production was 87.1 percent higher than in the same 1995 period. Nov 1996 production was down 85.9 percent from prewar average monthly output, and output is down 81.9 percent from the Jan-Nov 1991 period, the office said. --Sarajevo Newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
